timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What is Compliance Score actually measuring?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: It's a percentage based on how many improvement actions you've completed across your compliance controls.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: So it's just a to-do list with a score attached?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: A sophisticated to-do list. It maps controls to regulatory frameworks and prioritizes by risk impact.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, NIST, and many more. Each maps controls to that regulation.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Microsoft secures the cloud platform. You secure your data, configs, and access within it.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Does it distinguish between audit and assessment?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Yes. Audits verify controls are in place. Assessments identify gaps and recommend improvements.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Can I use it for continuous monitoring?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: That's the whole point. It continuously evaluates your posture and highlights what needs attention.
